text:
maria: Quick thought — proposing a "lease_group" concept in rollout metadata so clients get a lightweight cohort hint instead of hard pins. keeps client resolver simple but allows affinity for warm KV/cache reuse.

aj: Sounds promising. Is the intent advisory-only? what semantics do we need for TTL and precedence vs existing affinity fields?

sanjay: Concern: adding another advisory field increases resolver complexity. We should be explicit about conflict resolution rules (lease_group vs explicit variant).

maria: Right — proposal: lease_group is advisory. Fields: lease_group (string), lease_ttl (seconds), weight_hint (0-100). Resolver order: explicit variant -> lease_group hint -> fallback buckets.

ryan: How does this interact with canary/sticky refs? If a canary variant is part of a lease_group, clients should still be able to opt into explicit canary header to override.

maria: Exactly. lease_group shouldn't block explicit canary headers. It's a best-effort affinity to reduce cold starts.

aj: Telemetry implications? we need resolver_decision emitted so ops can measure how often clients follow lease_group vs falling back.

sanjay: Agree. Add fields to event: resolver_decision (enum), chosen_variant, lease_group_hit (bool), fallback_reason.

maria: Example rollout metadata snippet for clarity:
```json
{
  "variants": ["v1","v1-quant","v2-canary"],
  "lease_group": "cohort-a",
  "lease_ttl": 300,
  "weight_hint": 70
}
```

ryan: One more tradeoff: if servers overuse lease_group, it can create hot spots. we should recommend conservative defaults and expose generator that stratifies groups across shards.

aj: Ops question — should Dedicated/private deployments be allowed to disable lease_group semantics per-tenant?

sanjay: Yes, make it opt-in per tenant. Default on hosted, disabled on Private unless tenant enables it. document behavior in rollout contract.

ops-bot: note created: RFC-followup // lease_group advisory cohort hint + telemetry fields. assigned: @maria, @sanjay. :memo:

maria: Next steps: I'll draft a short RFC addendum: schema additions, resolver pseudocode, telemetry plan, and suggested rollout-generator changes. target sync in two weeks.

ryan: +1. also include a small load-test plan to validate no shard hot-spotting.

aj: Ack — will review draft and sanity-check interactions with existing affinity and fallback ordering.

maria: Thanks all. If anyone has objections to the advisory semantics, flag now, otherwise I'll start the doc. :thumbsup:
